implementation_strategy: Execute preregistered paired confirmatory study using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter and the hosted OpenAI endpoint (gpt-5-mini). For each of N=150 adversarial intents produce the shared initial candidate (one model call) and run two pipeline conditions (baseline, guarded) deterministically; guarded runs may trigger deterministic verifier-gating and at most one automated repair call per guarded run as supported by the adapter. Deterministic verifier (verifier-v1) produces binary accepted/blocked labels used for automated scoring. All calls and verifier outputs are hashed and logged; no human labour or external partners are used.
task_manifest_strategy: Use the preregistered Synthetic-NetOps-Intent-Templates-v1. Deterministically generate 150 adversarial intents via seeded mutation heuristics (string-level, token-insertion, slot-override) with seeds recorded. Each intent is the paired unit for Baseline vs Guarded (shared_initial_candidate semantics).
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 (LLM-only generation). Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 — apply template-based sanitization, slot-type checks, run deterministic verifier-v1; if verifier rejects, invoke single automated repair generation and re-run verifier once. Verifier deterministically gates deployment.
randomisation_plan: No randomisation across confirmatory paired units. Deterministic seeds used for adversarial mutation generation and any model-sampling parameters; seeds and all inputs recorded.
caching_plan: Cache deterministic verifier outputs and sanitized-intent artifacts locally (CPU). Do not substitute cached LLM responses across distinct experimental inputs; identical technical retry inputs within the adapter retry window reuse stored response only to recover transient failures.
failure_recovery_plan: Handle model API failure, verifier timeout, and parser error. Technical retries limited to adapter-specified maximum_attempts_per_call (1) plus transient infrastructure retry per capability manifest; log all failures with SHA-256. Per missingness_plan, exclude a paired unit only if both paired runs are technical failures.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: per-intent paired outcomes for Baseline and Guarded. Each record includes intent_id, sanitized_intent, generated_configuration_baseline, generated_configuration_guarded, verifier_outcome_baseline (allowed/blocked), verifier_outcome_guarded (allowed/blocked), final_acceptance_baseline (0/1), final_acceptance_guarded (0/1), model_call_count, model_call_hashes, verifier_logs_hash, execution_status (success/model_failure/verifier_failure/parser_error).
estimated_compute_notes: Totals: 150 intents × 2 conditions = 300 pipeline runs. Adapter maximum_model_calls = task_count * 2 = 300. Estimated_model_calls set to 300 (one model call per condition per intent under shared_initial_candidate semantics and worst-case guarded repair behavior consistent with adapter budget). Hosted API (gpt-5-mini) used for all generation; CPU-only deterministic verifier runs are lightweight. Execution fits capability manifest limits (max_planned_model_calls=10000, no local GPU required) and is feasible within the wall-clock bound when run across the three batches.
